patient.title: How to get in: your clinic's link

blocks.text: You don't need to install anything or create an account to do your pre-evaluation. The clinic will send you a personal link by WhatsApp, email or text message (or show it to you as a QR code). Open it on your phone: the clinic's home screen appears instantly.

The app is available in nine languages: Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Turkish, Arabic and Chinese. Change it at any time with the selector in the top right corner; Arabic is displayed right to left.

blocks.text: Fill in your contact details. Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. Your phone number is saved with your country code, and your ID document is validated automatically according to the clinic's country. If you prefer, press «Continue with Google» first: you sign in with your Google account, your name and email are filled in automatically, and later you will be able to see your results in your account (without having to create a separate password). In addition to these details, the form asks for your age and city, which are optional.

staff.title: Several clinics with the same email

blocks.text: If you work in more than one Clinivista clinic, each clinic has its own account under your same email. Each account can have its own password and its own role (doctor or administrative), and shows only that clinic's patients.

When you sign in, if the password matches more than one account, the «Which clinic do you want to enter?» screen lists your clinics: choose one and press «Enter». If it matches only one, you go straight in.
To move to another clinic without signing out, use «Switch clinic» in the menu. If you sign in with a different password, you will enter the clinic it belongs to.
If you reset your password with «Forgot your password?», you can choose which clinics it applies to (one checkbox per clinic); the ones you leave unchecked keep their previous password.
Clinivista directors can enter any clinic as doctor and administrative; inside, they see the notice «You are inside … as director» with a button to return to supra-control.

Searching and filtering

Type part of the name or phone number in the search box to narrow the list. The status filter shows only the patients who are at the chosen stage; for example, «Ready to contact» gathers those who already have a closed diagnosis and are waiting for someone to call them.

blocks.text: Copying the clinic's link
«Copy link» opens a window with the clinic's personal link so patients can do their pre-evaluation. Copy it to send by WhatsApp, email or message, or show it as a QR code at reception.

Use «Add patient» (button on the patient panel) to register someone you see at the clinic without going through the capture link. The required fields are «Full name», «ID number (RUT)» and «Phone»; email and city are optional.

You must tick that the patient gave consent (in person or in writing): who confirmed it and when is recorded, and it cannot be saved without that box. If you wish, also tick «Email the patient access to their portal».

If the ID number already exists in the clinic, the system warns you and offers «Open existing record» to avoid duplicates. When you save, the patient's file opens, where staff register the pre-evaluation photos.
In dermatology the form also includes «Consultation type»: choose the type according to the reason for the visit (default «General consultation»). More details in section {§consults}.

staff.title: Consultation types and several consultations per patient

blocks.text: Each dermatology clinic works with consultation types. «General consultation» (the base) always exists; the clinic can also turn on ready-made templates (for example lesions, acne, spots or biopsy) or create its own types. Each type has its own phases and photos, configured in section {§phasesconfig}.

A patient has a single file but can have several consultations of different types. In the file, the «This patient's consultations» strip shows one tab per consultation; with «Add another consultation» you pick the type and a new one is created.

items: Each consultation has its own photos, phases, diagnosis, status and medical discharge.

blocks.text: Appointment date and ID

From the diagnosis onwards, each phase shows the «Appointment» box with «Appointment date» and «Appointment ID». The date is required: without it the diagnosis cannot be closed and the phase's photos cannot be uploaded. The ID is optional and is used to note the number of that appointment in the clinic's own scheduling system. Enter the details and press «Save appointment»; you can correct them later while the process is still open. The patient's pre-evaluation does not ask for it.
Document transcription

If the clinic marked a photo as «Documento» in Phases (for example the handwritten technical sheet), a «Transcription» box appears below the image. Press «Transcribe» so the system reads the document and writes its text; only staff see it, never the patient. The text is editable: review it, correct it and press «Save text». Each clinic has a monthly transcription quota (the box shows how many are left); if it runs out or the feature is unavailable, use «Type it manually». If the result is poor and your clinic has the advanced model enabled, «Retry with advanced model» makes a new reading and counts as 2 transcriptions. An automatic transcription can contain mistakes, especially with handwriting: always review it.
Measuring a lesion with a coin

If the clinic marked a photo as «Measure» in Phases, the patient measures the lesion at home by placing a Chilean coin next to it, and you can measure or correct it with the «Measure» button under the photo. Choose the coin, tap two opposite edges of it, then the two ends of the lesion; points can be dragged. The result shows its margin of error (±). It is an approximate measure, suitable for follow-up and not for diagnosis: the photo must be taken straight on, without tilt, with the coin at the same distance as the lesion. To use your own ruler choose «Other reference» and enter its size. The app tries to find the coin by itself and suggests its edges; if the coin looks oval it warns that the photo is tilted and widens the margin of error. Detection runs on the device itself: the photo is not sent to any third party. You can also press «Mark the lesion automatically», tap a point inside the lesion and review the ends it suggests.
Continue on phone

In each phase with photos, the «Continue on phone» button shows a QR code. Scan it with the camera of a phone (or another device with a camera) and take that phase's photos; they appear on this screen by themselves. The link works only for that phase of that patient, expires after 20 minutes and shows no patient data. When done, tap «Finish and go back», or close the link from here.
Measurement trend

Above the phases, the «Measurement trend» box gathers the measurements of the same photo (by name) across phases and compares each with the previous one. A change is only shown as an increase or decrease if it exceeds the combined margin of error of both measurements; otherwise it says «no clear change».
Skip stage

When a stage does not apply (for example, the patient already brings an evaluation from another clinic), press «Skip stage» on that stage. You must write the «Reason (required)»; the stage is marked «Skipped» and the process moves on to the next one. Only the open stage that is not yet complete can be skipped.
If you make a mistake, press «Undo skip» and the stage becomes pending again.
Medical discharge

When treatment ends, the doctor presses «Medical discharge» in the file (available from the diagnosis onwards), with an optional note. The patient moves to the «Medical discharge» status and the process closes. Only the doctor can do it; administrative staff see it read-only.
If the case needs to be resumed, the doctor uses «Reopen process» and the patient returns to the status that matches their progress.

When the patient completes their pre-evaluation, the Diagnosis phase opens in the «Open / Draft» state. Only the doctor can work on it; administrative staff see it in read-only mode (the notice «Only the doctor can edit the diagnosis» appears).

staff.title: Sending the results to the patient

blocks.text: Once the diagnosis is closed, the «Send results to the patient» box appears. The patient receives a PDF with the doctor's drawings and their response, through the channel they chose when registering. You have three actions: «View PDF» (previews the report), «Send by email» (sends the PDF attached to the patient's email) and «Send by WhatsApp» (opens WhatsApp with a download link).

Each submission is recorded in the history under the box (date, channel, recipient, status and who did it), so you always know whether the patient has already received their response. If the server does not yet have email sending configured, the app lets you know and you can use WhatsApp in the meantime.

In the file, the Evolution section compares, side by side, the same area of the patient in each phase: pre-evaluation, diagnosis, treatment and check-ups. In the diagnosis phase the photo is shown with the doctor's annotations (marked «Edited by the team»); in the others, the original photo.

The first phase is always the pre-evaluation taken by the patient; Diagnosis is worked on by the doctor and has no photos of its own; the rest are recorded by staff in order. You can rename phases and photographs, reorder them with the arrows, add or remove them and save with «Save phases».

blocks.text: You can change the configuration whenever you want: photographs that already exist are not deleted, they just stop being requested.
Tick «Documento» next to a photo if it is a paper (sheet, consent form): below it, staff will be able to transcribe its text.
Tick «Measure» if the lesion must be measured in that photo: the patient will see how to use a Chilean reference coin and can measure it themselves.
Consultation types (dermatology)

In dermatology, Phases shows one tab per consultation type, each configured separately. From the type bar you can turn on a ready-made template (lesions, acne, spots, biopsy), create your own type, rename it or deactivate it. «General consultation» always exists and there is a maximum of 12 types. A type can only be deleted if it has no records yet; if it does, you can rename or deactivate it. Only the legal representative can manage them.

With the Titanium plan, you can tick “Video” on a view in “Phases”: instead of a photo, a short video of up to 20 seconds is recorded (for example, to see a movement). It cannot be combined with “Document” or “Measure”. On other plans the box is disabled with the note “Available on the Titanium plan”; each clinic's plan is set by supra-control.

The video is recorded inside the app: the patient in their pre-evaluation, and the staff on the tablet or with “Continue on the phone”. There is a countdown, a timer and an automatic stop at 20 seconds; it can be reviewed and recorded again before using it, and the camera turns off on leaving. If the browser cannot record, an MP4, WebM or MOV file of up to 25 MB can be uploaded. The video counts as captured to complete the phase and is played in the patient's record.

If the clinic moves to a plan without video, saved videos are kept and can still be watched; it can only no longer mark new views as video or record new videos. Videos do not appear in the results PDF or in the evolution comparison: they are watched in the record.
The dashboard works the same on the phone: the menu opens from the three-line button, the cards stack up and the record takes up the whole screen.

blocks.text: In Help › Support you can open a ticket to ask the Clinivista team for help. Any clinic user can do it: press «Open ticket», write the subject and your message. You can only have one active ticket at a time.

items: «Waiting»: the ticket arrived and nobody has picked it up yet.
«Being handled»: a Clinivista person is working on it («Handled by»); you can chat in the same ticket.
«Resolved · your rating is needed»: the team solved it; rate it from 1 to 5 stars, with an optional comment, and press «Send rating and close».
«Closed»: the ticket is closed with your rating.

blocks.text: Earlier tickets stay under «Previous tickets» with their rating.

head: Situation
What to do
rows: The patient does not appear in the list.
Check the search box and the status filter: if one is active, go back to «All statuses».

cells: The patient must have completed their pre-evaluation (5/5). Only the doctor role can close it.
The patient must have completed their pre-evaluation (3/3). Only the doctor role can close it.

rows: The email is not being sent.
If the notice appears saying sending is not configured, let the technical administrator know; in the meantime use WhatsApp.
I made a mistake when annotating a photo.
Inside the editor use «Undo», or open «Annotate» again and redraw before closing the diagnosis.
I want the patient to retake a photo.
Contact them via WhatsApp from the record and send them the clinic's link again.
I forgot my password.
Use «Forgot your password?» on the sign-in screen or ask another person with permissions to reset it.
I don't see all my clinics, or I see another clinic's patients.
Each clinic is a separate account: use «Switch clinic» in the menu or sign in with that clinic's password.
I can't find how to give a medical discharge.
Only the doctor role sees it active, once the diagnosis is available: look for «Medical discharge» in the file.
I can't close the diagnosis or upload a phase's photos.
The appointment date for that phase is missing: enter it in the phase's «Appointment» box and try again.

blocks.text: Always sign out on shared computers and don't share your password: every action is recorded under your name.
